name: Taurus Semantics
description: Defines Taurus semantic domains, boundaries, and prohibited derivations.

coreDomains.definition: Maintains an existing functional line across time without unnecessary interruption.
Reduces volatility enough for a target function to remain usable or coherent.
Strengthens what has already been initiated by gathering, integrating, or reinforcing it.
Keeps useful gains, resources, or structures available.
Protects functional value from unnecessary loss or disruption.
Sustains operation through repeated care or reinforcement.
Supports expression that remains viable across time and pressure.
Builds capacity through repeated additions rather than abrupt expansion.
Uses, preserves, and replenishes available resources with attention to continuity.
Regulates speed to support sustainability and retention.

boundaryRules: Continuity is not resistance to change.
Consolidation is not refusal to begin.
